title: Blissfully Yours
author: Ipsita Ganguli
text:
We, you and I
Float on the fluff of a cloud
And the drop of the rain
And the wings of the birds

Your heart sings a song
Which reaches me through
A gentle breeze
That settles on my cheeks

And We , you and I
Remain blissfully together
Bound by everyday heaven
That one finds all around us

Our heaven
The one that we built together
As our souls embraced
And then blew it to the winds

Knowing that heavenly bliss
Can never ever be tied
And bound and confined to
The pettiness of mundane worldliness

It is in the freedom of togetherness
That You remain
Blissfully mine
And I blissfully yours
stanzas: Float on the fluff of a cloud
And the drop of the rain
And the wings of the birds
That one finds all around us
The one that we built together
And then blew it to the winds
It is in the freedom of togetherness
